_comment: Everything the explorer can carry. kind: potion (heal = hit points), material, quest (cannot be sold), key, collectible, trophy, weapon (damage = sword multiplier, glow = blade colour), armor (armor = damage taken multiplier, frost/fire = extra multiplier against that element and for fire also lava). value = coins a merchant pays; price = coins to buy.

potion.name: Healing Draught
potion.desc: Bitter, warm, and very effective. Press H (or the flask button) to drink.

elixir.name: Glowcap Elixir
elixir.desc: Wren's improved remedy, brewed from Glow Hollow mushrooms. Heals twice as much.

iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.desc: Rough ore from the Frost Peaks.

ember_shard.name: Ember Shard
ember_shard.desc: Still warm. Glows when you breathe on it.

glow_spore.name: Glow Spore
glow_spore.desc: A luminous spore pod from Glow Hollow.

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.desc: Volcanic glass, sharp enough to shave with.

golem_core.name: Golem Core
golem_core.desc: A fist-sized stone that still hums with heat.

starsteel.name: Starsteel Ingot
starsteel.desc: Ancient metal that rings like a bell. Rare and precious.

rare_crystal.name: Resonant Crystal
rare_crystal.desc: A crystal that hums on its own. Nobody knows why.

magic_crystal.name: Heartlight Crystal
magic_crystal.desc: A crystal taken from the corruption's source, cleansed. It warms your hand and steadies your breath (+15 max health).

moonbell.name: Moonbell Flower
moonbell.desc: A pale blue flower that only blooms in Glow Hollow.

glowcap.name: Glowcap Mushroom
glowcap.desc: A cap that glows teal in the dark.

map_fragment.name: Ancient Map Fragment
map_fragment.desc: A torn piece of a very old map. The marks point to all five corners of the island.

ancient_relic.name: Ember Relic
ancient_relic.desc: A carved disc of black stone from the temple beneath the ashes. One of five matching slots is empty.

crystal_sample.name: Corrupted Crystal Sample
crystal_sample.desc: A shard of violet crystal. It flickers like something is looking out of it.

fragment_meadow.name: Fragment of Growth
fragment_meadow.desc: A green ancient fragment from Hub Meadow.

fragment_frost.name: Fragment of Stillness
fragment_frost.desc: A white ancient fragment from Frost Peaks.

fragment_ember.name: Fragment of Fire
fragment_ember.desc: A red ancient fragment from the Ember Wastes.

fragment_glow.name: Fragment of Light
fragment_glow.desc: A teal ancient fragment from Glow Hollow.

fragment_town.name: Fragment of Memory
fragment_town.desc: A golden ancient fragment hidden in Brickton.

supply_bag.name: Hale's Supply Bag
supply_bag.desc: Heavy with spices, needles and a lot of paperwork.

caravan_cargo.name: Caravan Strongbox
caravan_cargo.desc: The Ostrander caravan's strongbox. Still locked.

explorer_journal.name: Edric's Journal
explorer_journal.desc: Edric Vane's expedition journal. Several pages are missing.

journal_page.name: Journal Page
journal_page.desc: A torn page from Edric Vane's journal.

last_page.name: Edric's Last Pages
last_page.desc: Water-stained pages from the end of Edric's journal.

old_map.name: Old Treasure Map
old_map.desc: A crude map of Hub Meadow with three marks and a rhyme.

rusty_key.name: Rusty Iron Key
rusty_key.desc: Heavy and old. There's a crown stamped on the bow.

sun_key.name: Sun Key
sun_key.desc: A golden key shaped like a sunburst.

moon_key.name: Moon Key
moon_key.desc: A silver key shaped like a crescent.

star_key.name: Star Key
star_key.desc: A pale key shaped like a star.

shrine_shard.name: Shrine Shard
shrine_shard.desc: A carved piece of a shrine's mechanism.

treasure_map_frost.name: Frozen Map
treasure_map_frost.desc: A map drawn on hide. An X marks a spot in the Frost Peaks.

treasure_map_glow.name: Spore-Stained Map
treasure_map_glow.desc: A map of Glow Hollow, smelling of mushrooms. An X near the eastern pools.

ancient_coin.name: Ancient Coin
ancient_coin.desc: A coin from the old kingdom. A crowned tree on one side.

warden_sigil.name: Warden's Sigil
warden_sigil.desc: The mark of the island's Wardens.

trophy_cinderhulk.name: Cinderhulk's Core
trophy_cinderhulk.desc: Trophy: the molten heart of the ancient golem Cinderhulk.

trophy_gloomhorn.name: Gloomhorn's Horn
trophy_gloomhorn.desc: Trophy: the great horn of Gloomhorn.

trophy_rimeclaw.name: Rimeclaw's Claw
trophy_rimeclaw.desc: Trophy: a claw of ice that never melts.

trophy_sentinel.name: Sentinel's Eye
trophy_sentinel.desc: Trophy: the cracked crystal eye of the Hollow Sentinel.

trophy_queen.name: Queen's Mandible
trophy_queen.desc: Trophy: a mandible of the Beetle Queen.

trophy_greymane.name: Greymane's Pelt
trophy_greymane.desc: Trophy: the silver pelt of the great wolf Greymane.

trophy_guardian.name: Guardian's Crown
trophy_guardian.desc: Trophy: the crystal crown of the Ancient Guardian.

heart_blade.name: Heartforged Sword
heart_blade.desc: Bram forged a sliver of the three heart-stones into your blade.

hunter_blade.name: Hunter's Falchion
hunter_blade.desc: Brann's spare blade. Light and quick.

cinder_edge.name: Cinder Edge
cinder_edge.desc: Forged from Cinderhulk's core. The edge never cools.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.desc: Carved from Rimeclaw's claw. Leaves frost on whatever it cuts.

gloomfang.name: Gloomfang
gloomfang.desc: Gloomhorn's horn, honed into a blade.

kingsblade.name: Kingsblade of Caldor
kingsblade.desc: The last king of Caldor's sword, found in the royal chamber.

dawnbreaker.name: Dawnbreaker
dawnbreaker.desc: Legendary. The Wardens' blade, freed from the Ancient Guardian's crown.

frost_coat.name: Expedition Furs
frost_coat.desc: Cold-resistant furs. Frost creatures hit 40% softer.

ember_mantle.name: Ashwalker Mantle
ember_mantle.desc: Fire-resistant cloak. Fire creatures and lava burn 45% less.

royal_plate.name: Caldor Royal Plate
royal_plate.desc: Ancient plate from the royal chamber. 25% less damage.

warden_mantle.name: Warden's Mantle
warden_mantle.desc: The last Warden's mantle. Resists cold and fire.

explorer_compass.name: Edric's Compass
explorer_compass.desc: Its needle twitches toward places you haven't found yet. Undiscovered places show on your map.
